title: Breaking the Filter Bubble: A Semantic Pareto-DQN Framework for Multi-Objective Recommendation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by calculating the semantic variance (using the trace of the state trajectory's covariance matrix) of user embeddings over time to quantify the reduction of semantic collapse and the promotion of recommendation diversity.

Evaluated by tracking the cumulative platform exposure of recommended items and utilizing a monotonically decaying exposure reward to incentivize the exploration and recommendation of long-tail items.
